about.title: About Oqu
about.lead: “Oqu” means “reading” and “learning” in Kazakh. It is a course project: a digital library with a REST API documented with OpenAPI.
about.role_muhan: lead developer: architecture, server, interface, tests
about.tech_text: The server is written in Python with FastAPI, data is stored in SQLite, sign-in uses JWT tokens and passwords are hashed with PBKDF2. The interface is a single-page app in plain JavaScript with no build step. Every feature is available through the REST API, which you can explore and try right in the browser:
about.thanks_text: Thanks to our teacher Murat Zholdasbekovich Aitimov for the course “Cross-platform application development in Python”, for the freedom to choose our tools, and for questions that make us truly understand the subject.
